The shared target of Mcl-1 and the downstream effect on CWR22R suggests that the observed relationship may involve a pathway where Mcl-1 acts as a mediator, possibly through cellular signaling or transcriptional regulation. The integration of these findings supports the hypothesis that Abyssinone I may modulate Mcl-1 expression, which in turn affects CWR22R, though further experimental validation is required to confirm this mechanism.
